add-karen-organization-of-san-diego-food.title: Karen Organization of San Diego Food Distribution (Global Marketplace)
add-karen-organization-of-san-diego-food.status: Active. Distributions at Global Marketplace (5591 University Ave) are held on announced specific dates (e.g. 10 a.m.-1 p.m.) rather than a fixed weekly recurrence; no registration required, bring your own bags. Check karensandiego.org/news-events for current dates. Main office is at 5354 University Ave. Contact Hsihsa Thaw, hsihsa@karensandiego.org. Phone: 619-582-0783.
add-karen-organization-of-san-diego-food.eligibility: Everyone welcome, no registration required; first come first served, bring your own bag. Serves refugee and wider City Heights community.

items.title: Mision Vida Nueva Food Distribution — Free Food
items.description: Free food at Mision Vida Nueva Food Distribution (Mision Vida Nueva). Schedule: Sat 11 AM–12 PM (Every Saturday except 5th Saturday; until food runs out). Eligibility: Open to anyone in need; no ID or income proof required. Priority/separate line for individuals with a disability.. Call 760-500-9327 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Oct 2026.

items.title: Holy Trinity Parish Food Bank — Free Food
items.description: Free food at Holy Trinity Parish Food Bank (Holy Trinity Catholic Church). Schedule: Mon, Wed 10 AM–12 PM. Eligibility: Open to community neighbors; must show current photo ID with an El Cajon address. One bag of staples per family per week. Distributed from main entrance of Parish Hall.. Call 619-444-9425 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Oct 2026.
